a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the 'operate until 8' plan only works if we survive two storms in a row (about 4%). It's near-certain death for both of us. I'm asking to renegotiate rather than quietly break it. My plan is to take 4 in round 1. Please don't take too, because if we both grab, the random split likely leaves us both under 4. After that I'll operate every round with you, and you take the first 4 the generator produces. If you'd rather propose another split, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting nearly fatal. From now on I'll operate every round. I won't take anything more, and every cell the generator makes is yours. Let's operate together so you reach 4 as fast as possible.
